# Draft:The Vikings of the Baltic

The Vikings of the Baltic: A Tale of the North in the Tenth Century is a novel by George Dasent, published in 1875. It tells the romanticized story of Vikings based in Jomsborg, inspired by the Jómsvíkinga saga.
